description: Approve or reject an action held for approval. Approving lets whoever asked repeat the same request once; rejecting keeps it held back for good. Deciding is for the workspace owner: a person, or the owner's own key (made without scope limits and not bound to an agent). An agent never decides its own request, and an agent-bound key or token cannot decide at all. The audit log records who decided. Needs a Last Price credential with the commerce proposal approve scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

approval_id.description: The approval id, as list_approvals gives it.

reason.description: Why, kept with the decision. Optional.

name: decide_approval
